title: Grandparents and a family genealogy trip to Barbados
summary: He names his maternal and paternal grandparents and recalls a family trip to the island's Hall of Records to find his father's birth certificate.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: My grandfather's name was Edmond Spense, and my grandmother's name was... I'll have to come back to that. She died a long time ago. [AMANDA TOLLS SPENSE]
My paternal grandparents... I never saw my grandfather, although I know all about him now. His name was Benjamin. And my paternal grandmother's name was Adelaide.
Did they live in the Islands?
Yes, they never left the Islands. There's many branches of the family. I have a... Later I'll show you. I have a... What do you call it? You can lay it out on the floor and you can see all of the...

Genealogy, yeah; the family tree. My daughters, Sharon and Sylvia, and my wife, Mary Lou, and I, went down there five years ago. It didn't matter it me, but they were interested, so they went to the Hall of Records and found my father's birth certificate, where he was baptized and the whole bit. So it gives one a sense of family pride.
Anyhow, we knew where we came from, which is pretty wild. This happened before Roots, too.
